class.name: IfcCondenser
class.brief_description: A condenser is a device that is used to dissipate heat, typically by condensing a substance such as a refrigerant from its gaseous to its liquid state. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcCondenser defines the occurrence of any condenser; common information about condenser types is handled by IfcCondenserType .
